CITY_VOICE_CUE_1: AXIOM-7: Three shipments secured. Both uplinks are down. Regional patrols have lost their shared targeting feed.
CITY_VOICE_CUE_2: AURA: Listen. No coordinates. No orders. Just a little room between the noise. I can work with that.
CITY_VOICE_CUE_3: MIRAGE: Enjoy it while it lasts. Their eyes are down, not their weapons. I’ve marked a way out.
CITY_VOICE_CUE_4: OCEANUS: Send the recovered power back toward the neighborhoods. They’ve been keeping people cold to keep these fences burning.
CITY_VOICE_CUE_5: TITAN: Put those crates on the service line. We hauled enough weight for their machines. Let it carry something useful.
CITY_VOICE_CUE_6: KAITO: They’ll come looking for this depot. Make sure the supplies leave before we do.
CITY_VOICE_CUE_7: AURA: A short signal. No names, no coordinates. Just this: the checkpoint is open, and you are not alone.
CITY_VOICE_CUE_8: MIRAGE: The route reaches the Border Fortress. I can get us to its approaches. Getting through that wall is another matter.
CITY_VOICE_CUE_9: AXIOM-7: The fortress runs on its own power. Its guns will still be waiting.
CITY_VOICE_CUE_10: KAITO: Then we go together. This city has waited long enough.
